status: Rules fixed before comparing two-year returns. User correction: do not calculate fees or slippage. The earlier costed trial is archived and excluded.
cost_assumption: No fees or slippage, explicitly requested by user

variants.high_low_ema: 高低价 EMA31 通道，无 ATR

rules.execution: Confirmed close decisions, next-open execution; reverse on opposite signal; ignore repeated same-side signals; close at end; no additional TP/SL orders or leverage.
rules.band_variants: The fitted EMA variants retain their previous trigger thresholds. High-low channel: EMA(hl2,31) ± 0.99*EMA(high-low,31). WMA41 and SMA28: close source ±0.99*ATR16. Dual EMA26/36 hl2: average center ±2.2*half absolute spread. EMA-only uses center crossings.
rules.original: Original RSI/volume/cooldown signals retained; signal-to-position mapping and reverse-only exit are study assumptions, not rules supplied by the Pine indicator.
rules.benchmark: Buy-and-hold first signal at first main close, fill at next open, close at last close; same sizing as strategies. Cash return fixed at zero, no interest.
rules.selection: Among the 12 non-benchmark variants, require positive return, profit factor >1 and at least 30 completed trades in selection period; rank by return / maximum close-equity drawdown, break ties by return. If none qualify, no qualifying winner. Do not reselect using validation returns.
rules.robustness: Report full-period returns, calendar month returns, trade counts, long/short breakdown and standalone validation/recent segments; also check long-only results to separate synthetic short contributions.
rules.inference_limits: These parameters were influenced by an August 2026 screenshot. Historical split validation excludes that interval but is not a strictly prospective or blind experiment. No guarantee of statistical significance or future performance.
